visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy with glasses and a black t-shirt sits on a wooden chair against a plain white background, holding and reading several sheets of paper. Gold-colored text overlays the top half of the screen. (2) The boy stands up while maintaining eye contact with the camera, still clutching the papers in his right hand. He begins to speak with an inquisitive expression and active hand gestures. (3) The camera zooms in to a medium close-up of the boy's face; he points his left index finger directly towards the viewer with a serious look. Bold black and red text appears across his chest. (4) The boy extends both arms outward in a shrugging gesture, looking directly at the lens. The text at the bottom changes as he continues to speak. (5) A sudden cut shows a close-up of a test paper on a white surface, with a handwritten score of '68' circled in red ink at the top. (6) Back to the studio, a woman wearing a shiny silver sleeveless dress enters the frame from the right and pushes the boy while he is sitting. The boy stumbles away with a wide grin, laughing.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 10秒告訴你 六科都考滿分的秘密. (2) [Subtitle]: 你知道 如何六科都考滿分嗎?. (3) [Subtitle]: 當你知道時 記得告訴我. (4) [Subtitle]: 因為 我也不知道. (5) [Variety]: (......).

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A child's high-pitched voice begins speaking with a confident, storytelling tone. An upbeat electronic pop BGM with a driving 4/4 beat starts simultaneously. (2) The boy's vocal intensity remains moderate as he poses a rhetorical question, punctuated by slight variations in pitch contour. (3) A brief 'whoosh' transition SFX is heard as the boy delivers a punchline. His speech rate remains steady, but the emotional valence shifts to humorous. (4) The BGM continues with bright synthesized textures. The boy's voice displays clear articulation. (5) A distinct paper-rustling sound occurs during a brief pause in speech. (6) A woman's high-pitched laughter and a sharp exclamation are heard, accompanied by the sound of physical shuffling and the chair hitting the floor. The music continues to the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Question -> Subversion -> Reveal -> Comedic Reaction
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A comedic short-form video designed for social media engagement. A young boy uses a clickbait-style hook to promise secrets for perfect grades, only to reveal he has no idea and actually scored poorly, concluding with a lighthearted physical gag.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video's humor relies on the contrast between the boy's confident presentation and the reality of his low test score.
